description: This file defines a Java interface 'Command' for commands understood by the Ditto framework, including nested enums and classes for command categories and JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A Java interface representing a command in the Ditto framework, with methods for command properties and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Command.Category
classes.description: An enum categorizing commands into QUERY, MODIFY, and DELETE types.

classes.name: Command.JsonFields
classes.description: An abstract class containing common JSON field definitions for commands, including 'ID' and 'TYPE'.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the command.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by the command, defaulting to the latest if not specified.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON representation of the command, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns a JSON object of the command with specified schema version and predicate filtering.
